import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0FiniteStageTripleModelComparisonNamed
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0FiniteStageTripleTransitionModels

/-!
# The face equation for transported finite-stage triple transitions

The concrete comparison from each scalar-extended finite-stage triple model to the exact
triple-intersection ring preserves both tensor-pushout faces.  Conjugating the exact cyclic
transition by these comparisons therefore carries the rotated right face to the original
left face after the descended pair transition.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory TensorProduct
open scoped TensorProduct

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

noncomputable section

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] [IsSepClosed k]

section

set_option linter.style.setOption false
set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 400000
set_option maxHeartbeats 6400000

variable {F : Type u} [Field F] [Algebra F k]
variable (L : DatG0.FinSubext F k)
variable (n m : Pic0FiniteStageRingIndex C -> Nat)
variable (relation : forall j, Fin (m j) -> MvPolynomial (Fin (n j)) L.1)
variable (e : forall j,
  k ⊗[L.1] DatG0.FiniteRelationAlgebra L.1 (n j) (m j) (relation j) ≃ₐ[k]
    Pic0FiniteStageRing C j)
variable (M : DatG0.FinSubext L.1 k)
variable (mapM : forall q : Pic0FiniteStageMapIndex C,
  Pic0FiniteStageModelRing C L n m relation M
      (Pic0FiniteStageMapSource C q) →ₐ[M.1]
    Pic0FiniteStageModelRing C L n m relation M
      (Pic0FiniteStageMapTarget C q))
variable (hmapM : forall q,
  (Algebra.TensorProduct.map M.1.val
      (AlgHom.id L.1
        (DatG0.FiniteRelationAlgebra L.1
          (n (Pic0FiniteStageMapTarget C q))
          (m (Pic0FiniteStageMapTarget C q))
          (relation (Pic0FiniteStageMapTarget C q))))).comp
      ((mapM q).restrictScalars L.1) =
    ((pic0FiniteStageTransportedMap C L n m relation e q).restrictScalars
      L.1).comp
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.map M.1.val
        (AlgHom.id L.1
          (DatG0.FiniteRelationAlgebra L.1
            (n (Pic0FiniteStageMapSource C q))
            (m (Pic0FiniteStageMapSource C q))
            (relation (Pic0FiniteStageMapSource C q))))))

set_option maxHeartbeats 3200000 in
-- The family codomain contains a dependent named tensor-pushout instance.
/-- The concrete triple-model comparisons, packaged in the family shape used by the
transported cyclic transitions. -/
noncomputable def pic0FiniteStageTripleModelComparisonFamily
    (q : Pic0FiniteStageTripleTransitionIndex C) :=
  pic0FiniteStageTripleModelComparison
    C L n m relation e M mapM hmapM q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2

set_option maxHeartbeats 3200000 in
-- The transported map conjugates two dependent triple-model comparisons.
/-- The exact cyclic transition transported through the concrete triple-model
comparisons. -/
noncomputable def pic0FiniteStageTransportedTripleTransitionOfModels
    (U V W : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :=
  pic0FiniteStageTransportedTripleTransition C L n m relation M mapM
    (pic0FiniteStageTripleModelComparisonFamily
      C L n m relation e M mapM hmapM) (U, (V, W))

set_option maxHeartbeats 3200000 in
-- Inferred source and target types preserve the component-comparison instances.
/-- The exact pair transition conjugated through the two component model comparisons. -/
noncomputable def pic0FiniteStagePairModelComparisonTransition
    (U V : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :=
  (pic0FiniteStageModelBaseChangeEquiv
      C L n m relation e M (Sum.inr (U, V))).symm.toAlgHom.comp
    ((pic0FiniteStageTransition C (U, V)).comp
      (pic0FiniteStageModelBaseChangeEquiv
        C L n m relation e M (Sum.inr (V, U))).toAlgHom)

set_option maxHeartbeats 6400000 in
-- The proof reduces three dependent comparisons and their face maps simultaneously.
/-- The transported cyclic transition carries the scalar extension of the rotated right
face to the scalar extension of the original left face after the pair transition. -/
theorem pic0FiniteStageTransportedTripleTransition_fac
    (U V W : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :
    (pic0FiniteStageTransportedTripleTransitionOfModels
        C L n m relation e M mapM hmapM U V W).comp
        (AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom
          (R := M.1) (K := k)
          (pic0FiniteStageTripleModelFaceRight
            C L n m relation M mapM V W U)) =
      (AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom
        (R := M.1) (K := k)
        (pic0FiniteStageTripleModelFaceLeft
          C L n m relation M mapM U V W)).comp
        (pic0FiniteStagePairModelComparisonTransition
          C L n m relation e M U V) := by
  let QUVW := pic0FiniteStageTripleModelComparison
    C L n m relation e M mapM hmapM U V W
  let QVWU := pic0FiniteStageTripleModelComparison
    C L n m relation e M mapM hmapM V W U
  let EUV := pic0FiniteStageModelBaseChangeEquiv
    C L n m relation e M (Sum.inr (U, V))
  let EVU := pic0FiniteStageModelBaseChangeEquiv
    C L n m relation e M (Sum.inr (V, U))
  let tau := pic0FiniteStagePairModelComparisonTransition
    C L n m relation e M U V
  have hright := pic0FiniteStageTripleModelComparison_faceRight
    C L n m relation e M mapM hmapM V W U
  have hleft := pic0FiniteStageTripleModelComparison_faceLeft
    C L n m relation e M mapM hmapM U V W

75	noncomputable def pic0FiniteStageAffineTripleTransition
    76	    (thetaN : forall p : Pic0FiniteStageTripleTransitionIndex C,
    77	      N.1 ⊗[M.1] Pic0FiniteStageTripleTransitionModelSource
    78	          C L n m relation M mapM p →ₐ[N.1]
    79	        N.1 ⊗[M.1] Pic0FiniteStageTripleTransitionModelTarget
    80	          C L n m relation M mapM p)
    81	    (U V W : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :
    82	    Pic0FiniteStageTripleBaseChangeRing
    83	        C L n m relation M mapM N V W U →ₐ[N.1]
    84	      Pic0FiniteStageTripleBaseChangeRing
    85	        C L n m relation M mapM N U V W :=
    86	  (pic0FiniteStageTripleBaseChangeEquiv
    87	      C L n m relation M mapM N U V W).toAlgHom.comp
    88	    ((thetaN (U, (V, W))).comp
    89	      (pic0FiniteStageTripleBaseChangeEquiv
    90	        C L n m relation M mapM N V W U).symm.toAlgHom)
    91	
    92	/-- Conjugating the descended cyclic transitions onto the literal tensor-pushout rings
    93	preserves their three-cycle identity. -/
    94	theorem pic0FiniteStageAffineTripleTransition_cocycle
    95	    (e : forall j,
    96	      k ⊗[L.1] DatG0.FiniteRelationAlgebra L.1 (n j) (m j) (relation j) ≃ₐ[k]
    97	        Pic0FiniteStageRing C j)
    98	    [Algebra.IsAlgebraic M.1 k]
    99	    (hmapM : forall q,
   100	      (Algebra.TensorProduct.map M.1.val
   101	          (AlgHom.id L.1
   102	            (DatG0.FiniteRelationAlgebra L.1
   103	              (n (Pic0FiniteStageMapTarget C q))
   104	              (m (Pic0FiniteStageMapTarget C q))
   105	              (relation (Pic0FiniteStageMapTarget C q))))).comp
   106	          ((mapM q).restrictScalars L.1) =
   107	        ((pic0FiniteStageTransportedMap C L n m relation e q).restrictScalars
   108	          L.1).comp
   109	          (Algebra.TensorProduct.map M.1.val
   110	            (AlgHom.id L.1
   111	              (DatG0.FiniteRelationAlgebra L.1
   112	                (n (Pic0FiniteStageMapSource C q))
   113	                (m (Pic0FiniteStageMapSource C q))
   114	                (relation (Pic0FiniteStageMapSource C q))))))
   115	    (thetaN : forall p : Pic0FiniteStageTripleTransitionIndex C,
   116	      N.1 ⊗[M.1] Pic0FiniteStageTripleTransitionModelSource
   117	          C L n m relation M mapM p →ₐ[N.1]
   118	        N.1 ⊗[M.1] Pic0FiniteStageTripleTransitionModelTarget
   119	          C L n m relation M mapM p)
   120	    (hthetaN : forall p : Pic0FiniteStageTripleTransitionIndex C,
   121	      (Algebra.TensorProduct.map N.1.val
   122	          (AlgHom.id M.1
   123	            (Pic0FiniteStageTripleTransitionModelTarget
   124	              C L n m relation M mapM p))).comp
   125	          ((thetaN p).restrictScalars M.1) =
   126	        ((pic0FiniteStageTransportedTripleTransitionOfModels
   127	          C L n m relation e M mapM hmapM p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2).restrictScalars
   128	            M.1).comp
   129	          (Algebra.TensorProduct.map N.1.val
   130	            (AlgHom.id M.1
   131	              (Pic0FiniteStageTripleTransitionModelSource
   132	                C L n m relation M mapM p))))
   133	    (U V W : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :
   134	    (pic0FiniteStageAffineTripleTransition
   135	        C L n m relation M mapM N thetaN U V W).comp
   136	        ((pic0FiniteStageAffineTripleTransition
   137	          C L n m relation M mapM N thetaN V W U).comp
   138	          (pic0FiniteStageAffineTripleTransition
   139	            C L n m relation M mapM N thetaN W U V)) =
   140	      AlgHom.id N.1
   141	        (Pic0FiniteStageTripleBaseChangeRing
   142	          C L n m relation M mapM N U V W) := by
   143	  let betaUVW := pic0FiniteStageTripleBaseChangeEquiv
   144	    C L n m relation M mapM N U V W
   145	  let betaVWU := pic0FiniteStageTripleBaseChangeEquiv
   146	    C L n m relation M mapM N V W U
   147	  let betaWUV := pic0FiniteStageTripleBaseChangeEquiv
   148	    C L n m relation M mapM N W U V
   149	  have hthetaN' : forall p : Pic0FiniteStageTripleTransitionIndex C,
   150	      (Algebra.TensorProduct.map N.1.val
   151	          (AlgHom.id M.1
   152	            (Pic0FiniteStageTripleTransitionModelTarget
   153	              C L n m relation M mapM p))).comp
   154	          ((thetaN p).restrictScalars M.1) =
   155	        ((pic0FiniteStageTransportedTripleTransition C L n m relation M mapM
   156	          (pic0FiniteStageTripleModelComparisonFamily
   157	            C L n m relation e M mapM hmapM) p).restrictScalars M.1).comp
   158	          (Algebra.TensorProduct.map N.1.val
   159	            (AlgHom.id M.1
   160	              (Pic0FiniteStageTripleTransitionModelSource
   161	                C L n m relation M mapM p))) := by
   162	    intro p
   163	    simpa only [pic0FiniteStageTransportedTripleTransitionOfModels] using hthetaN p
   164	  have hcycle := pic0FiniteStageTripleTransitionModel_cocycle
   165	    C L n m relation M mapM
   166	      (pic0FiniteStageTripleModelComparisonFamily
   167	        C L n m relation e M mapM hmapM)
   168	      N thetaN hthetaN' U V W
   169	  apply DFunLike.ext _ _
   170	  intro x
   171	  change betaUVW
   172	      (thetaN (U, (V, W))
   173	        (betaVWU.symm
   174	          (betaVWU
   175	            (thetaN (V, (W, U))
   176	              (betaWUV.symm
   177	                (betaWUV
   178	                  (thetaN (W, (U, V)) (betaUVW.symm x)))))))) = x
   179	  rw [betaVWU.symm_apply_apply, betaWUV.symm_apply_apply]
   180	  have hx := DFunLike.congr_fun hcycle (betaUVW.symm x)
   181	  calc
   182	    _ = betaUVW (betaUVW.symm x) := congrArg betaUVW hx
   183	    _ = x := betaUVW.apply_symm_apply x
   184	
   185	end

   187	end

   189	end AlgebraicGeometry
